02-01-empty: Empty dark desktop; waybar with date, Volume 40% and Connected; the Chat ... pill sits over the bar at the top right. No tag or layout indicator in the bar.
02-02-terminal: Super+Return opens a shell that fills the whole area under the bar.
02-03-cat: cat friday.md prints the Friday list in the terminal.
02-04-window-2: Second window (Notes content) opens as master on the left; the shell moves to the right.
02-05-window-3: Third window (wobbly.rs): master left, Notes and the shell stacked at the right.
02-06-window-4: Fourth window: master left, three windows stacked at the right.
02-07-layout-tile_left: Super+space: tile_left, master on the right, stack at the left.
02-08-layout-tile_bottom: Next layout: tile_bottom, master on top, the others in a row below.
02-09-layout-fair: After two more presses the layout is fair: a 2x2 grid.
02-10-focus-pointer: The pointer over the lower right window gives it the focus (follow mouse); no focus mark is visible, so the change cannot be seen in the picture.
02-12-closed: Super+Shift+c closes the focused window (the shell); the three others fill the grid.
02-13-to-tag-2: Super+Shift+2 sends the focused window to tag 2; it vanishes from tag 1 and the bar shows no sign of tag 2.
02-14-tag-2: Super+2: tag 2 shows the moved wobbly.rs window alone; the bar looks the same as on tag 1.
02-15-tag-1: Super+1: the other windows are back.
02-16-bar-hover: The pointer over Connected shows a tooltip eth0 192.0.2.2/24.
02-17-chat-panel: Super+a opens a white chat panel at the right (about 200 px wide) with Chat with a helper, Close and 1 Atlas working; the field has the keyboard at once; the bar tooltip stays on top of it.
02-18-picked: 1 and Return pick Atlas: header Atlas working Tidy notes (1/2), Stop, Close, the transcript.
02-19-sent: The message is sent (field empty); the transcript shows no line for it (the fake agent does not echo it).
